title: How a Martha Stewart-backed centre is rethinking elderly care
summary_full: Established by Martha Stewart, the Martha Stewart Center for Living at Mount Sinai Hospital is dedicated to transforming the landscape of elderly healthcare. Through its focus on holistic well-being and specialized programs, older adults benefit from improved health outcomes, including reduced emergency visits and shorter hospitalizations. Furthermore, the center prioritizes educating healthcare professionals in geriatric practices, reinforcing a commitment to effectively support our ageing community.
